provenance_note: Curated for China student healthcare pathways.

pathways.label: Peking University International Hospital (北京大学国际医院)
pathways.description: Tertiary referral hospital with an international department and English-speaking staff. Direct billing depends on your active policy network status.
required_documents: Active student or commercial insurance certificate
uncertainties: This pathway lists verification steps, not a guarantee of coverage or direct billing.
steps: Book an appointment through the international desk or official hospital channel.
Present your passport, student ID, and insurance certificate at registration (挂号处).
Complete the outpatient consultation and keep the medical record (病历).
Confirm whether direct billing applies to your policy or obtain an official fapiao (医疗发票) for reimbursement.
requirements: Active insurance policy covering outpatient care.
Direct billing requires prior confirmation that the hospital and department are in your insurer network.

pathways.label: United Family Healthcare (和睦家医疗)
pathways.description: International private hospital with bilingual clinical staff. Out-of-pocket costs and direct billing depend on your policy terms and pre-authorization rules.
required_documents: Pre-authorization or claim form if required by your insurer
uncertainties: This pathway lists verification steps, not a guarantee of coverage or direct billing.
steps: Schedule an appointment via the hospital booking line or website.
Verify with your insurer whether private international clinics are covered under your plan.
Present your passport and insurance details before treatment.
Collect the itemized bill, medical record, and official fapiao if paying upfront.
requirements: Check whether private international clinics are excluded or subject to a higher co-payment under your policy.

pathways.label: Beijing Chaoyang Hospital (北京朝阳医院)
pathways.description: Public Class 3A (三甲) hospital. Services are primarily in Mandarin with upfront payment at the hospital cashier and post-visit reimbursement via official fapiao.
required_documents: Hospital registration card or digital registration code
Official medical fapiao (医疗发票), itemized bill, and medical record for reimbursement
uncertainties: This pathway lists verification steps, not a guarantee of coverage or reimbursement.
steps: Register for an outpatient department number (挂号) at the hospital kiosk or counter.
Wait for your queue number in the outpatient clinic area.
Pay consultation, diagnostic, and medication charges at the hospital cashier.
Request the official medical fapiao (医疗发票), itemized expense list (费用清单), and outpatient medical record (门急诊病历) for claim filing.
requirements: Upfront payment is generally required; submit official receipts afterward for reimbursement review.
Mandarin language support may be needed during registration and consultation.

pathways.label: 120 Emergency Department (急诊)
pathways.description: Immediate emergency care for life-threatening or severe acute symptoms at the nearest emergency hospital.
required_documents: Any available identification (passport or student card)
steps: Call 120 for an ambulance immediately or go to the nearest hospital emergency department (急诊).
Prioritize medical stabilization before administrative paperwork.
Notify your insurer emergency assistance line as soon as practical.
requirements: Seek immediate emergency medical care for severe chest pain, breathing difficulty, or other red-flag symptoms.
